# `÷` — Reciprocal / Divide

Function. Keys: `Alt-u`. Hanzi: `除`. Ranks: `0` monadic, `0 0` dyadic

`÷Y`: 1/Y. Pervasive. `X÷Y`: X/Y. Pervasive. Machine integers use floor division. Float arguments use floating division, and `ᵣ` arguments use exact rational division. Select float or rational division explicitly with `÷ₐ` or `÷ᵣ`:

```bpl
÷4                ⍝ 0.25
1ₓ÷3ₓ             ⍝ 0ₓ
¯3ₓ÷2ₓ            ⍝ ¯2ₓ
1ₓ÷ₐ3ₓ            ⍝ 0.3333333333333333
1ᵣ÷3ᵣ             ⍝ 1ᵣ3
1ₓ÷ᵣ3ₓ            ⍝ 1ᵣ3
```

A nonzero float divided by zero gives an infinity. Floating zero divided by zero gives zero for [Mathish types](../terms.qmd#term-mathish-types) with [Mathish mode](../numbers.qmd#mathish-mode) enabled, and NaN otherwise:

```bpl
¯1÷0              ⍝ ¯∞
0÷0               ⍝ 0
```

## Inverse

`÷⁻¹` is `÷`. With the right argument fixed, `(÷↢X)⁻¹Y` is `Y×X`. These recover the original value for nonzero floating or rational division; integer floor division loses the remainder.

```bpl
12÷⁻¹4     ⍝ 3
(÷↢4)⁻¹3   ⍝ 12
```

## Errors

- `DOMAIN`: a character argument
